policy: Transforms are pinned to the verified source SHA-256.
Generated derivatives are candidates until exact-pixel visual approval.
Do not crop away architecture-defining centaur body geometry merely to remove the inset.

Two earlier candidates were rejected during visual review: border-median sampled inset hair, then a 0.34-height white mask left a residual inset strip. The current 0.43-height white mask is the next reviewed candidate.
The 0.64-left-edge candidate left a vertical inset remnant; the current 0.60-left-edge candidate is explicitly pending visual review for possible main-hair clipping.
Current candidate coordinates are derived from the byte-verified source image's disconnected foreground components, not visual guesswork.
